Former "Jon & Kate Plus 8" star Collin Gosselin is speaking out about alleged abuse he says he endured growing up.

"Simply put, my whole life that I lived was a lie," Gosselin said. "All the things you see on TV, lies."

Read more: https://t.co/PFK88VLkfl
Pope Leo revealed Sunday that he will undergo surgery to remove a nodule on his lung. Doctors say once it is removed, tests will determine whether it is benign or cancerous. https://t.co/0igvFRcaYS
Thousand-pound pumpkins are dropped from a crane as part of a smashing ceremony during the Harvest Festival in Stillwater, Minnesota. https://t.co/arFjut7XZ7
